summary: Codex implementation of VS-025: Complete child-safe nutrition, training, and body progression sandbox loop. All acceptance criteria addressed: (1) Kid can find/prepare age-appropriate protein and carbohydrate foods via FoodDatabase with 15+ food items, (2) Progress is gradual, optional, reversible with bounded levels (max 3) and no calorie restriction/shame/body-size scoring, (3) Third-person player model gains bounded stronger posture via TrainingStats with BlendShape-based visual progression (training_manager.gd now updates mesh BlendShape weights for muscles_defined, posture_improved, shoulders_back, chest_out), (4) HUD communicates food, energy, and training with icons, progress bars, captions, and optional voice feedback. Domain layer maintains hexagonal architecture boundaries. BlendShape implementation completes visual body progression requirement. Ready for claude cross-review.
